verdict.rationale: Nitrokey publishes an official Python SDK on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2) alongside the nitropy CLI, so developers can integrate the keys into their own software, and a community report praises the dev tools and documentation for the Nitrokey HSM. The evidence covers only a Python package; there are no documented SDK APIs, language bindings, or mobile (Android/iOS) SDK. The NetHSM REST API is explicitly scoped to the appliance, not the USB keys, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented SDK API reference, mobile SDKs for Android/iOS, multi-language desktop bindings, hands-on corroboration of app integration.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs let me integrate the key into my own desktop and mobile apps

citations.quote: The official Python SDK also resolves on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2).
dev tools and documentation are top notch, integration with OpenSC is very good.
